builder.scope: all 24316 original and all 24179 seven-day graphs from raw source ZIPs
builder.training_gate: any mismatch stops fitting; preserve mismatch evidence before correction

calibration.fit: validation-only NLL; logT bounds [-4,4]; ranking uses unclipped scores
calibration.models: all seven-day models with saved validation probabilities, including preserved R317 arms

chain_prior: training chain positive fractions only; unseen chain uses pooled training prior

feature_schema.full24: n,e,density; mean/median/max of retained in/out/total degrees; mean/median/max of 3 full-history x columns; chain one-hot
feature_schema.note: Removing explicit counts/density does not eliminate implicit size information from degree summaries
feature_schema.single_feature_method: train-only balanced logistic regression, standardized on training only; one deterministic fit per configuration

lightgbm.selection: maximum validation AP; fixed grid-order tie break; test evaluated for selected model only

neural.capacity: parameter counts differ explicitly; no equal-capacity claim
neural.extra_training_metrics: fork RNG for extra monitoring to avoid consuming shuffle/dropout stream
neural.gin_size: same encoder; head includes train-standardized log1p(retained nodes), log1p(retained edges)
neural.gin_sum: same encoder; mean+max+sum readout + chain; larger head recorded
neural.test_access: one prediction pass after selecting checkpoint

oneclass.score: negative score_samples, fixed orientation; no calibration/probability claim

operating.tie: stable frozen sample order; expectation and attainable bounds

oracle.continued: last>=first+7d; future-conditioned descriptive subset, never eligibility
oracle.score: negative log1p(full archive observed span in days); fixed retrospective orientation
oracle.use: ORACLE/RETROSPECTIVE DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; not a model input or performance upper bound

preprocessing: StandardScaler training rows only; inherited splits/cutoffs/labels unchanged
public_release: HOLD: no push/tag/DOI/portal action without exact-file approval and rights evidence

statistics.family: R319 new four-comparison exploratory family, disjoint from preserved R317 7+6 families
statistics.paired_unit: same seven-day test contracts and same five seeds; mean per-seed AP difference

stopping: fixed diagnostic grid; no test-driven retry, reorientation, threshold or best-seed selection

subgroups.inadequate: both classes required for point AP/ROC; below CI threshold report support and point only
subgroups.unit: contract observations; fixed checkpoints; within-stratum ordinary bootstrap; unknown actor dependence
